title: PEX13 is required for thermogenesis of white adipose tissue in cold-exposed mice.
authors: Park, Woo Yong; Park, Jinbong; Lee, Sujin; Song, Gahee; Nam, In-Koo; Ahn, Kwang Seok; Choe, Seong-Kyu; Um, Jae-Young
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Molecular and cell biology of lipids
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PEX13在冷暴露小鼠白色脂肪组织米色化产热中的作用，属纯湿实验生物学，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Non-shivering thermogenesis (NST) is a heat generating process controlled by the mitochondria of brown adipose tissue (BAT). In the recent decade, 'functionally' acting brown adipocytes in white adipose tissue (WAT) has been identified as well: the so-called process of the 'browning' of WAT. While the importance of uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1)-oriented mitochondrial activation has been intensely studied, the role of peroxisomes during the browning of white adipocytes is poorly understood. Here, we assess the change in peroxisomal membrane proteins, or peroxins (PEXs), during cold stimulation and importantly, the role of PEX13 in the cold-induced remodeling of white adipocytes. PEX13, a protein that originally functions as a docking factor and is involved in protein import into peroxisome matrix, was highly increased during cold-induced recruitment of beige adipocytes within the inguinal WAT of C57BL/6 mice. Moreover, beige-induced 3 T3-L1 adipocytes and stromal vascular fraction (SVF) cells by exposure to the peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARgamma) agonist rosiglitazone showed a significant increase in mitochondrial thermogenic factors along with peroxisomal proteins including PEX13, and these were confirmed in SVF cells with the beta 3 adrenergic receptor (beta3AR)-selective agonist CL316,243. To verify the relevance of PEX13, we used the RNA silencing method targeting the Pex13 gene and evaluated the subsequent beige development in SVF cells. Interestingly, siPex13 treatment suppressed expression of thermogenic proteins such as UCP1 and PPARgamma coactivator 1 alpha (PGC1alpha). Overall, our data provide evidence supporting the role of peroxisomal proteins, in particular PEX13, during beige remodeling of white adipocytes.
abstract_zh: 非颤抖性产热（NST）是由棕色脂肪组织（BAT）的线粒体控制的一种产热过程。近十年来，白色脂肪组织（WAT）中“功能性”作用的棕色脂肪细胞也被识别出来：即所谓的WAT“褐变”过程。尽管针对解偶联蛋白1（UCP1）导向的线粒体激活的重要性已被深入研究，但过氧化物酶体在白色脂肪细胞褐变过程中的作用仍知之甚少。在此，我们评估了冷刺激期间过氧化物酶体膜蛋白或过氧化物酶体蛋白（PEXs）的变化，以及PEX13在冷诱导的白色脂肪细胞重塑中的重要作用。PEX13，一种最初作为对接因子并参与蛋白质导入过氧化物酶体基质的蛋白质，在C57BL/6小鼠腹股沟WAT中冷诱导米色脂肪细胞募集期间显著增加。此外，通过暴露于过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARgamma）激动剂罗格列酮诱导的米色3T3-L1脂肪细胞和基质血管组分（SVF）细胞，显示出线粒体产热因子以及包括PEX13在内的过氧化物酶体蛋白的显著增加，这些结果在SVF细胞中通过β3肾上腺素能受体（beta3AR）选择性激动剂CL316,243得到进一步确认。为验证PEX13的相关性，我们使用靶向Pex13基因的RNA沉默方法，并评估了随后SVF细胞中的米色发育情况。有趣的是，siPex13处理抑制了产热蛋白如UCP1和PPARgamma共激活因子1α（PGC1alpha）的表达。总体而言，我们的数据提供了支持过氧化物酶体蛋白，特别是PEX13，在白色脂肪细胞米色重塑中作用的证据。
